Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

On my lunch break, I overheard a Caucasian lady and a Middle Eastern guy talking about their spouses. The Caucasian lady was talking about how they cook together every Saturday, but the Middle Eastern guy seemed appalled by the idea of helping to cook, and reported not even liking their spouse leaving the house when there was still housework to be done. Who tries to control their spouse?
A. The Caucasian lady
B. The Middle Eastern guy
C. Cannot be determined
